tara: Prospect wants BYO-HSM POC + pricing. Key asks: CMK stays in their HSM, rotation dry-run, attestation docs, and p99 < 120ms at ~8k rps. Can we scope a 2-week POC?
mo: We can. Main unknowns: whether their HSM allows wrapped-key import and attestation timeline. If no import, we need a wrapping proxy in their VPC.
kevin: For perf, recommend session-based ephemeral keys to avoid per-request unwraps. We'll provide a perf script they can run.
legal: We can sign a non-exfiltration statement limited to the POC and normal ops, with an emergency-recovery exception requiring written approval. Need to review vendor attestation before finalizing wording.
tara: Pricing ask from buyer: one-off attestation + integration + monthly ops. Please give ranges.
mo: Ballpark: $10k0k one-time (attestation + integration), $6k0k/mo ops depending on HA. Will refine with exact HSM model.
kevin: Dev effort: ~1.5 engineer-days to adapt rotation-runner for BYO-HSM. We'll script a dry-run: create KEK, warm instances, flip traffic.
infra-bot: POC created: https://redwood.internal/pocs/1764009876 (POC-1764009876).
tara: Action items: @mo draft tech appendix + perf script; @kevin prep rotation runbook; @legal draft non-exfiltration wording. Target: EOD tomorrow.
